title: Rewrite Factory Model v1.0 — Design Reference (Not Activated)
status: DESIGN REFERENCE — Not activated per S724 DEFER decision

label_edits_no_rewrite.description: DL-031 difficulty label corrections (Moderate→Easy), DL-032 case uniform difficulty changes. These are field-value changes, not content rewrites.

genuine_rewrites.description: DL-013 boilerplate replacement (851 fields across ~280 items), EC expansion (short ECs, missing principle references), DL-012 clone seed remediation (28 seeds need original distractor explanations)
genuine_rewrites.priority: MEDIUM — affects learner experience but not safety

boilerplate_replacement.description: Replace 'represents a plausible misconception' template text with choice-specific distractor explanations

ec_expansion.description: Expand ExplanationCorrect from ~213 chars to 500+ chars with principle reference, formula trace, business interpretation

clone_seed_remediation.description: Author original distractor explanations for archived DL-012 clone seeds

operating_model.recommendation: Embed rewrite work in existing 800-series certification waves. Do not create a separate rewrite lane.
operating_model.rationale: EC expansion depends on stable CorrectChoice — must follow certification, not precede it. A separate Rewrite Factory adds a second certification pass, increasing total sessions. The 800-series HYBRID certification pipeline already addresses genuine rewrite needs during the certification audit.
operating_model.ec_expansion_sequence: Certify item → EC validated against certified CC → Expand EC → Re-verify against CAQS §4. This must happen post-certification.

ew_templates.value: High — 3-4 templates by question type (calculation error, conceptual error, misapplication) would accelerate authoring velocity ~20-30% at 0.5 session cost
ew_templates.recommendation: Build the seed (1 session), not the full library

misconception_library.value: Medium — useful as authoring reference but high maintenance cost. Start with top 20 concepts.

distractor_library.value: Low — distractor patterns are topic-specific and don't transfer well between domains. Overhead exceeds benefit.
